knowledge.title: Knowledge Base
knowledge.body: The most successful cakes balance structure builders such as flour, egg whites, and binders with structure softeners such as sugar or sweetener and fat. In keto baking, wheat flour and sugar are typically replaced with almond flour, a little coconut flour, baking sweetener like erythritol or allulose, and extra eggs.
points: Almond flour: moist, tender, nutty. About 8-11 g net carbs per 100 g. Crumbles without eggs or binders.
Coconut flour: 3-4 times more absorbent than almond flour. Use about one quarter of the amount and many more eggs. Otherwise the cake turns sawdust-dry.
Eggs: the skeleton of keto cakes. Coconut flour cakes often need 5-6 eggs per 60 g coconut flour.
Erythritol sweetener: zero net carbs, but can leave a cooling aftertaste and a drier crumb. Allulose sweetener holds moisture better.
Xanthan gum or psyllium: replaces gluten's stickiness and reduces crumbling.
Rule of thumb per 100 g nut flour: about 2 eggs (85–100 g), 45–50 g fat, 40–50 g baking sweetener, 25 g yogurt or cream and 1 tsp baking powder.
Swap coconut flour 1:4 for almond flour: 30 g coconut flour replaces 110 g almond flour, plus one extra egg per 30 g and about 25% more liquid. Rest the batter 5 minutes.
Sweetness per gram: erythritol about 70% of sugar, allulose about 70%, xylitol 100%. Pure stevia and monk fruit extracts are 150–400× and add no bulk, so the model does not count them gram for gram.
Keto cakes stay pale: polyols do not brown. Allulose and tagatose brown like sugar, but fast, so lower the oven 10–15 °C or tent with foil.
Bake nut-flour cakes at 160–175 °C and never above 180 °C. Tent with foil after 25–35 minutes if the top is golden before the centre is set.
Erythritol recrystallises in the fridge within 1–3 days and turns gritty. Use powdered sweetener or allulose in frosting and cheesecake.
Fix eggy taste with more fat, vanilla or citrus zest and 1 tsp apple cider vinegar per 6 eggs. Vinegar or lemon juice also activates baking soda.
Wet fruit and vegetables must be drained: squeeze grated zucchini in a towel, macerate rhubarb 30 minutes and pour off the juice, toss berries in a little coconut flour.
Per-slice targets: under 5 g net carbs is very keto-friendly, 5–10 g is acceptable. A 12-slice cake should stay under about 60 g net carbs in total.
Coconut fiber flour and shredded coconut are different ingredients. The flour absorbs far more liquid. Home-blended nuts and seeds keep their fat and are not defatted flour.
Chia and oat fiber bind liquid but are not gel binders like xanthan. Count them as flour and adjust the liquid. Gelatin: 7 g in 45 g water replaces one egg, at most 1–2 eggs per cake.
Net carbs per 100 g are calculated on batter weight before baking, not on the finished cake. Per slice depends on how many slices you cut. Scores are model estimates; a test bake decides.
Xylitol and similar kabocha sweeteners are lethal to dogs. Polyols above 30–40 g per person have a laxative effect.

phrases.Tilføj ingredienser for at få en vurderi: Add ingredients to get an assessment.
phrases.en lille form (15–18 cm) eller 6–8 muffi: a small tin (15-18 cm) or 6-8 muffins
phrases.en 24 cm form eller to 18 cm lagkageform: a 24 cm tin or two 18 cm layer cake tins
and line the base with parchment paper.
phrases.Pisk æggehvider med en knivspids salt og: Whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt and optional cream of tartar until stiff peaks form. Fold in the sweetener gradually.
phrases.lyst og luftigt i 2–3 minutter. Har du f: until pale and fluffy for 2-3 minutes. If the recipe uses cream cheese, beat it in here as well.
phrases.Tilsæt æg, og eventuelt blommer, ét ad g: Add the eggs, and yolks if using, one at a time and beat well between each addition so the batter emulsifies. Stir in the vanilla and optional coffee.
phrases.Pisk æg og sødemiddel sammen, indtil bla: Beat the eggs and sweetener until the mixture becomes lighter and slightly thick. Add the vanilla and other liquid flavorings.
phrases.Smelt den mørke chokolade over vandbad e: Melt the dark chocolate over a water bath or in short microwave bursts. Let it cool for a couple of minutes and stir it into the rich base.
phrases.I en anden skål blandes alle tørre ingre: In another bowl, combine all the dry ingredients: flour, cocoa, leavening, salt, spice, and binder. Whisk or sift well to prevent lumps.
phrases.Vend de tørre ingredienser i den våde ma: Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture with a spatula. Stop when only a few dry streaks remain so the cake does not turn tough or dense.
phrases.Tilsæt væske, olie eller creme til sidst: Add liquid, oil, or cream last and adjust the consistency. The batter should be spreadable, not runny like pancake batter. Coconut flour thickens after 2-3 minutes, so wait a bit before adding more liquid.
phrases.Vend frugt og eller hakkede nødder i til: Fold in fruit and or chopped nuts at the end so they do not get crushed or sink unnecessarily.
phrases.Lad dejen hvile 3–5 minutter, så kokosme: Let the batter rest for 3-5 minutes so the coconut flour can absorb liquid. Then spread it into the tin and smooth the top.
phrases.Fordel dejen i formen og glat toppen let: Spread the batter into the tin and smooth the top lightly. Tap the tin once on the counter to release large air pockets.
phrases.minutter. Midten må gerne være lidt blø: minutes. The center can stay a little soft if you want the sticky kladdkaka style. A skewer may come out with a little moist crumb attached.
phrases.minutter, til toppen er sat og en tands: minutes, until the top is set and a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs. Nut-flour cakes dry out quickly if overbaked.
phrases.Køl 10 minutter i formen, løsn kanten og: Cool for 10 minutes in the tin, loosen the edge, and move the cake to a rack. Slice only when almost cool, otherwise it crumbles more easily.
phrases.Forslag til topping: pisk flødeost med l: Topping idea: whip cream cheese with a little sweetener and lemon juice into a thick frosting and spread it over the cooled cake.
phrases.Forslag til topping: lav en ganache af p: Topping idea: make a ganache with heavy cream and dark chocolate, or spread on a thin layer of buttercream. A classic option is a simple chocolate glaze.
phrases.Forslag til topping: rør citronglasur af: Topping idea: make a lemon glaze with sweetener and lemon juice, or serve with whipped cream and lemon zest.
phrases.Servér med flødeskum, bær eller en skefu: Serve with whipped cream, berries, or a spoonful of creme fraiche. A dusting of powdered sweetener on top gives a neat bakery finish.
Note: the assessment points to a dry batter. Consider one extra egg or 20-40 g more liquid before baking.
phrases.Bemærk: dejen ser meget våd ud. Bag et p: Note: the batter looks very wet. Bake a few minutes longer, or stir in 10-15 g extra almond or coconut flour.
phrases.Bemærk: høj smuldring. 1 tsk xanthangumm: Note: high crumbling. 1 tsp xanthan gum or 1 tbsp psyllium makes the cake easier to slice.
phrases.Skærper sødmen og får kagen til at smage: Sharpens sweetness and makes the cake taste finished. Start with 1-2 g.
phrases.Uden en klar smagsakse scorer kagen lavt: Without a clear flavor direction, the cake scores low on taste.
phrases.Sænker smuldring markant i kager med nød: Greatly reduces crumbling in nut-flour cakes.
Coconut flour drinks up liquid. One extra egg per 20-25 g coconut flour is a good starting point.
phrases.Kakao tørrer og bliver flad uden fedt el: Cocoa dries out and tastes flat without fat or a little coffee to boost it.
phrases.Prøv allulose-sødning eller munkefrugt-b: Try allulose sweetener or monk fruit blend for sweetness without raising net carbs.
phrases.10–20 % af melmængden som kokosmel giver: 10-20% of the flour amount as coconut flour adds more bite and absorbs excess fat.
phrases.Syre klæder flødeost og løfter en ellers: Acidity suits cream cheese and lifts an otherwise heavy cake.
phrases.Prøv bagesødning som allulose og byt hve: Try a baking sweetener like allulose and swap wheat flour for almond flour plus a little coconut flour.
phrases.Tekstur og aroma uden at ændre strukture: Texture and aroma without changing the structure too much.
phrases.Forbered vådt fyld: pres revet squash i: Prepare wet fillings: squeeze grated zucchini in a towel, macerate rhubarb with a little sweetener for 30 minutes and pour off the juice, and toss berries in a tablespoon of coconut flour.
